model.note: Shots on goal. Poisson GLM for the mean (consistent under over-dispersion) priced through a negative binomial: per player SOG runs variance/mean 1.13 against the 1.00 a Poisson assumes. Individual Corsi and Fenwick were tested and dropped - r=0.93 and 0.98 with career SOG/game, and worse alone. Same shape as the NFL receptions model.

Anytime goal scorer. Poisson GLM on goals per skater-game (variance/mean 1.004 - Poisson, not NB) with P(1+ goal) = 1 - exp(-mu), then isotonic calibration fitted on walk-forward out-of-sample predictions. A separate even-strength / power-play split was tested and is worse than one model.
